title: Day spa — appointment reminder
prompt: Appointment reminder email for Serenity Day Spa. Remind the client about their 60-minute deep tissue massage tomorrow at 2:00 PM. Include the address (418 Willow Lane, Austin TX), what to expect on arrival (arrive 15 minutes early, robe and slippers provided), a button to reschedule or cancel, and our 24-hour cancellation policy. Calm, reassuring tone.

title: Skincare studio — win-back offer
prompt: Win-back email for Glow Skin Studio, a facial and skincare clinic. It goes to clients who haven't booked in 3 months: offer 20% off their next facial, valid for 14 days. Introduce our new HydraFacial treatment with its main benefits, include a short client testimonial, and a Book now button.

title: Wellness center — holiday gift cards
prompt: Holiday gift card promotion for Lotus Wellness Center (yoga classes, massage and acupuncture). Buy a $100 gift card, get a $20 bonus card for yourself. Show three gift ideas with prices, a Buy a gift card button, and the deadline: December 24. Warm, festive but not pushy tone.

title: Hair salon — new client welcome
prompt: Welcome email for new clients of Maple & Moss Hair Salon, sent after their first visit. Thank them, introduce their stylist (Jenna, 8 years of color experience), share 3 tips for keeping their new color fresh, offer 15% off their second visit within 30 days, and include a Book your next appointment button. Friendly, personal tone.

title: Med spa — post-treatment aftercare
prompt: Aftercare email from Radiance Med Spa, sent the evening after a client's first Botox treatment. Do's and don'ts for the first 24 hours and the first 2 weeks, what's normal (mild redness, small bumps) versus when to call us, a reminder that results appear in 3â14 days, a button to book the free 2-week follow-up, and the clinic phone number (512) 555-0147. Clear, caring, professional.

title: Yoga studio — monthly newsletter
prompt: November newsletter for Still Water Yoga Studio. A short note from the founder, new schedule highlights (Sunrise Vinyasa Tue/Thu 6:30 AM, Restorative Yoga Fri 7 PM, new Prenatal Yoga Sat 10 AM), a teacher spotlight, a winter workshop on December 7 ($45, limited to 20 spots) with a Reserve your spot button, and a member tip on building a home practice. Calm, community feel.

title: Drunk Elephant — lapsed customer, routine refresh
prompt: Email from Drunk Elephant to customers who haven't ordered in six months. Invite them to rebuild their routine around Protini Polypeptide Cream, explain the 'clean-compatible' idea in one line, mention free shipping on orders over $50, and offer a Rebuild my routine button. Confident, playful, a little cheeky, no hard sell.

title: Glossier — product launch
prompt: Launch email from Glossier announcing a new shade of Cloud Paint called Haze, a dusty mauve. Explain who it suits, how to apply it with fingers, mention it's $24 and ships free over $40, and include a Shop Haze button and a second link to the full Cloud Paint range. Playful, friendly Glossier tone.

title: Headspace — come back to your practice
prompt: Email from Headspace to members who haven't meditated in two weeks. Welcome them back without guilt, suggest a 3-minute breathing exercise to restart, mention the new Sleep by Headspace wind-down series, and include a Start a 3-minute session button. Warm, light, encouraging.
